pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-vertex geometric regions with jagged, non-linear edges. Internal pigmentation shows a radial gradient, darker in the center with softer pixel transitions toward the perimeter. Spatial area of patches is larger on the flank and smaller on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space graph of light-colored pelage. Junction nodes predominantly exhibit three-way intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways is non-uniform, showing widening at major junction vertices and narrowing between large flank patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible 1D contour along the neck mane exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background vegetation.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct dark, avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) attached to the upper neck and shoulder region, creating high-contrast structural occlusions over the pelage pattern.
